cues.text: to love with our whole hearts, even though there's no guarantee --
cues.en: to love with our whole hearts, even though there's no guarantee --

cues.text: and that's really hard,
cues.en: and that's really hard,
cues.zh: 尤其身為一個家長，我告訴你們，當我們恐懼時

cues.text: and I can tell you as a parent, that's excruciatingly difficult --
cues.en: and I can tell you as a parent, that's excruciatingly difficult --
cues.zh: 尤其身為一個家長，我告訴你們，當我們恐懼時

cues.text: to practice gratitude and joy in those moments of terror,
cues.en: to practice gratitude and joy in those moments of terror,

cues.text: when we're wondering, "Can I love you this much?
cues.en: when we're wondering, "Can I love you this much?
cues.zh: 當我們想：「我能否這麼愛你？」

cues.text: Can I believe in this this passionately?
cues.en: Can I believe in this this passionately?

cues.text: Can I be this fierce about this?"
cues.en: Can I be this fierce about this?"

cues.text: just to be able to stop and, instead of catastrophizing what might happen,
cues.en: just to be able to stop and, instead of catastrophizing what might happen,
cues.zh: 能夠停下來，別把一切想的太糟糕

cues.text: to say, "I'm just so grateful,
cues.en: to say, "I'm just so grateful,
cues.zh: 「因為會感到脆弱代表我還活著」

cues.text: because to feel this vulnerable means I'm alive."
cues.en: because to feel this vulnerable means I'm alive."
cues.zh: 「因為會感到脆弱代表我還活著」

cues.text: And the last, which I think is probably the most important,
cues.en: And the last, which I think is probably the most important,

cues.text: is to believe that we're enough.
cues.en: is to believe that we're enough.

cues.text: Because when we work from a place, I believe, that says, "I'm enough" ...
cues.en: Because when we work from a place, I believe, that says, "I'm enough" ...

cues.text: then we stop screaming and start listening,
cues.en: then we stop screaming and start listening,
cues.zh: 那我們便會停止抱怨並開始傾聽

cues.text: we're kinder and gentler to the people around us,
cues.en: we're kinder and gentler to the people around us,
cues.zh: 我們對身邊的人會更溫柔仁慈

cues.text: and we're kinder and gentler to ourselves.
cues.en: and we're kinder and gentler to ourselves.
cues.zh: 對自己也會更溫柔仁慈

cues.text: That's all I have. Thank you.
cues.en: That's all I have. Thank you.

cues.text: (Applause)
cues.en: (Applause)
